kusapattaparitthato.g: kusapattehi paritthato sappidadhimadhu-ādīni pakkhipitvā aggi jalayitumāraddho āsi, evaṁ aggiṁ jāletvā “mahājanassa dānaṁ dassāmī”ti evaṁ cintetvā ṭhitassa mamāti ayamettha attho.
